result:
RCA complete. Summary:

**Root cause**: `tight_task_schema_violation` (a deterministic, content-based check against `prompt.txt`) was missing from the pre-flight hard-stop allowlist in `worker-entrypoint.sh` (and identically in `doc-worker-entrypoint.sh`), so it fell to the "transient" branch and systemd blindly retried it — an identical rejection every time. Worse, pre-flight rejections never call `record_failure_signature()`, so the circuit breaker designed to catch exactly this kind of pathological retry never saw the failures at all. (The specific "contradiction" text flagged for item 29 was itself a validator false-positive that resolved when `prompt.txt` was edited externally between attempts 3 and 4 — a coincidence, not a fix.)

**Fix applied**: added `tight_task_schema_violation` to the hard-stop condition in both `/opt/veridian/scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh` and `/opt/veridian/scripts/doc-worker-entrypoint.sh` (live infra, not tracked in this git repo), so this class of failure now checkpoints `blocked` + disables the unit instead of retry-storming.

**known_fixes row**: `{signature: "PRE-FLIGHT REJECTED (tight_task_schema_violation, transient)", fix_action: "hardstop_tight_task_schema_violation", success_count: 1}`, confirmed via `superboss-register.py log-fix`.

PROGRESS.md committed and pushed (`aea07b6`), task checkpointed `status=pending_review`.
